text:
Elaine (People Ops): @here Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: regional retreat & travel ops — trying to lock guidance for managers. I'll paste Qs, pls reply.

Sam (Eng): Timeline for approvals? Need to book flights now or wait for budget sign-off?

Elaine (People Ops): Managers can approve bookings up to $800 per person; anything above requires finance director sign-off. Bookings should target the window we discussed (May 12-16). Use the Travel Portal: https://redwood.internal/travel to submit requests. Receipts in the expense system within 60 days. :calendar:

Mike (Product): Are partners/guests allowed to join the retreat? Also rooms — single vs shared?

Elaine (People Ops): Guests allowed only with manager pre-approval and covered personally unless pre-authorized. Rooming: company covers standard single occupancy for distributed hires; if you want to upgrade share the delta or get manager pre-approval.

Carla (Finance): Quick add — anything > $1,200 needs director signoff before booking. Per diem for meals is $60/day domestic, lodging receipts required. Put "retreat" in the expense title so we can code it to the right budget.

Ana (CEO): small note — we want folks to come if they can, but absolutely no one should feel pressured to attend for personal reasons. If travel creates hardship pls flag to your manager or People Ops and we can accommodate. :heart:

Linda (Office Ops): Desk booking during travel weeks: if you're out, please release your desk in the Workspace app so others can reserve. Satellite hubs will have a drop-in area; lockers available on first-come basis.

ops-bot: Offsite calendar event created: Team Retreat — May 12-16. RSVP deadline Apr 15. (automated)

Ravi (Eng): One last Q — if flights are refundable and cheaper later, should we wait or book now?

Elaine (People Ops): If price delta < $150 and flight is refundable, book now. If unsure ping your manager and tag People Ops. We'll surface any budget blockers during the booking review. Thx!
